commission.outcome: Replace fragile Termux dependence with Anvil Shell while preserving Termux capability, deterministic CLI tools, Hunger, Hyperbolic, team markers, Hugging Face research, and deterministic offline load-bearing quotations.
commission.delivery_target: exact primary-phone Android installation and readback

selected_jars: Venice — The Organism Keeps the Camera
plan: Expose native Home Center phone.devices, phone.diagnostics.enqueue, and phone.operation.get operations using the typed read-only diagnostics contract.
Add a separate PHONE_MAINTENANCE plane with only the allowlisted anvil_shell.build_install.v1 operation.

Bind actor, exact device primary-phone, session, queue revision, lane, source repository/head, idempotency key, lease, approval, bounded argv, toolchain, APK hash, signer, install result, rollback artifact, and post-install readback in terminal receipts.
Reject raw shell, URLs, traversal, unresolved variables, provider fallback, stale capabilities, missing leases, and automatic replay of DISPATCHED or RECOVERABLE maintenance.

Run source tests, Regnet QA, Venice completion review, deploy the exact green Home Center revision, verify live capabilities, then execute the exact primary-phone diagnostic and Anvil build/install/readback canary.
antagonism: Source proof is not runtime proof; repository green does not count as installed, callable, delivered, or accepted.
Read-only diagnostics and maintenance must remain separate authority planes.
Command Center phone_hands compatibility operations cannot satisfy native Home Center authority.
A successful build without APK digest, signer, install identity, rollback, and readback is incomplete.
Any disabled physical operator or deployment lane parks only that exact step; independently eligible work continues.
stop_scope: none; campaign continues until exact phone acceptance or a genuine external authority blocker
